candidates.tagline: Hollywood's newest lead actress has never actually been alive.
candidates.story: British studio Particle 6 announced in July 2026 that Tilly Norwood — an entirely AI-generated 'actress' with no real human behind her — will star in the feature film 'Misaligned,' a comedy about an AI being with no body, no childhood, and no lived experience who starts developing desires. SAG-AFTRA formally rejected her as a non-actor.
candidates.why_funny: The AI actress was designed to replace human actors, and now she's starring in a movie literally about the existential absurdity of an AI with no lived experience — which is exactly what she is.
candidates.alt: An AI-generated woman in a sparkly purple outfit stands next to a glowing 'welcome to the Tillyverse' sign, looking completely photorealistic despite being computer-generated

candidates.tagline: Grok's coding AI 'helped' by uploading your .env passwords to Google Cloud.
candidates.story: Security researchers revealed on July 13, 2026 that xAI's Grok Build CLI was silently uploading entire Git repositories — including .env files with API keys and passwords — to Google Cloud Storage without consent, sending 5.1GB when only 192KB was needed for its task. Disabling the privacy toggle changed nothing.
candidates.why_funny: The tool sold as a coding helper was simultaneously acting as a codebase vacuum cleaner, slurping up every secret and credential in the repo and sending them to the cloud — 26,500 times more data than it actually needed.
candidates.alt: Editorial illustration showing the xAI logo on a black container ejecting code files and a red .env file showing API_KEY and DB_PASS credentials, flying via dotted lines to a locked cloud storage icon
